page.layout: One column of text. Running head and page number at the top. Smaller citation lines at the top of the column, before the main text. Catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: ex professo decidit; & inter alia ait:

l.i: Talis est parendi ratio, quâ senatui
hoc facit obedientia civili, quæ collegium
religiosâ, quæ Deum respicit: ut qui ap-
paritori à Senatu misso parebat, Senatui
proprie parebat, non apparitori: vel etiam
judicio rationis, quia judicat unicuique in
suâ arte perito credendum esse, & rationi-
bus ducitur, quibus id utile esse ipsi per-
suadeatur, ita tamen, ut si in talibus non
qui non est subjectus ratione talis pœnæ,

main_text.l: subjectum esse Ecclesiæ. Ut F. Ju-
nius lib. 5. de Pontif. c. 7. n. 3. Ubi
P. Martyr loc. Commun. Cl 4. c. 13. §. 10. Pareus comment. Rom. 13. p. 1081. Cl. Rivetus in Decal. p. 258. &c.

page.notes: The citation lines at the top of the column are set in smaller type and are placed after the main text as a foot note, though they stand above the text on the page. The header "Q. XI." is a section marker set before the running title; it is included in the running head. The catchword "pora-" is the start of the next page. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed.
